scope: 12 exact Arduino board models; genuine manufacturer designs only, clone layouts excluded
rules: Counts describe physical header positions, not GPIO counts
Separate opposite board edges are separate 1-row groups, not one adjacent 2-row connector
Female socket groups cannot directly mate with female jumper combs
2-row ICSP/debug groups are excluded from full single-row comb counts; never flatten 2×3 into 1×6
Candidate counts require actual JIG size availability and measured housing/clearance validation; all fits unverified
For without-header SKUs, geometry is footprint-only until correct male headers are soldered
USB and other non-header connectors are listed as obstructions, not exhaustively catalogued
